record.paper_title: Control theory of stochastic distributed parameter systems: recent progress and open problems
record.context_brief: regularity of controls in exact controllability
record.original_question: Consider the refined stochastic wave-like control system in which dy = ȳ dt + (a4 y + f) dW in Q, d ȳ - Σ_{j,k}(a_jk y_{x_j})_{x_k} dt = (a1·∇y + a2 y + a5 g) dt + (a3 y + g) dW in Q, y = χ_{Γ0} h on the boundary, and the controls are f, g, and h. Exact controllability is known for this model when the diffusion control g belongs to L²_F(0,T;H^{-1}(G)). The open question is whether exact controllability still holds when g is required only to lie in L²_F(0,T;L²(G)), equivalently whether one can prove the corresponding adjoint observability estimate using the boundary observation ∂z/∂ν on Γ0 together with the interior terms a5 z + Z and O^Z in L²(G).

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $G\subset\mathbb{R}^n$ be a bounded domain with smooth boundary $\Gamma=\partial G$, let $\Gamma_0\subset\Gamma$ be a nonempty relatively open subset, fix $T>0$, and set $Q=(0,T)\times G$. Let $(\Omega,\mathcal{F},\{\mathcal{F}_t\}_{t\ge 0},\mathbb{P})$ be a complete filtered probability space carrying a one-dimensional standard Brownian motion $W$, and let $L^2_{\mathcal F}(0,T;X)$ denote the Hilbert space of $\{\mathcal F_t\}$-adapted processes with values in a Hilbert space $X$ that are square integrable in $(t,\omega)$.

Assume $(a_{jk})_{1\le j,k\le n}$ is a symmetric, uniformly positive definite matrix of $C^2(\overline G)$-functions, and let
$$a_1\in L^\infty_{\mathcal F}(0,T;W^{1,\infty}(G;\mathbb R^n)),\qquad a_2,a_3,a_4,a_5\in L^\infty_{\mathcal F}(0,T;L^\infty(G)).$$
Consider the controlled stochastic wave-like system
$$\begin{cases}
 dy=\bar y\,dt+(a_4 y+f)\,dW & \text{in }Q,\\[2pt]
 d\bar y-\sum_{j,k=1}^n(a_{jk}y_{x_j})_{x_k}\,dt=(a_1\!\cdot\!\nabla y+a_2 y+a_5 g)\,dt+(a_3 y+g)\,dW & \text{in }Q,\\[2pt]
 y=\chi_{\Gamma_0} h & \text{on }(0,T)\times\Gamma,\\[2pt]
 (y(0),\bar y(0))=(y_0,\bar y_0) & \text{in }G,
\end{cases}$$
where the unknowns are $(y,\bar y)$ and the controls are $f,g,h$, with prescribed regularities $f\in L^2_{\mathcal F}(0,T;L^2(G))$, $h\in L^2_{\mathcal F}(0,T;L^2(\Gamma_0))$.

The system is called exactly controllable at time $T$ if for every initial datum $(y_0,\bar y_0)\in L^2(G)\times H^{-1}(G)$ and every $\mathcal F_T$-measurable target $(y_1,\bar y_1)\in L^2_{\mathcal F_T}(\Omega;L^2(G)\times H^{-1}(G))$ there exist controls $(f,g,h)$ in the admissible classes for which the corresponding solution satisfies $(y(T),\bar y(T))=(y_1,\bar y_1)$ a.s.

It is known that exact controllability holds when $g$ is allowed to range over $L^2_{\mathcal F}(0,T;H^{-1}(G))$. The question is:

Does exact controllability of the above system at some $T>0$ still hold under the strictly stronger requirement
$$g\in L^2_{\mathcal F}(0,T;L^2(G))\,?$$

Equivalently (by duality), does there exist $C>0$ such that every solution $(z,Z,O^Z)$ of the corresponding backward adjoint stochastic hyperbolic system satisfies the observability estimate
$$\|(z(0),Z(0))\|_{H^1_0(G)\times L^2(G)}^2\;\le\;C\,\mathbb E\!\int_0^T\!\!\int_{\Gamma_0}\!\Big|\tfrac{\partial z}{\partial\nu}\Big|^2 d\Gamma\,dt\;+\;C\,\mathbb E\!\int_0^T\!\!\int_G\big(|a_5 z+Z|^2+|O^Z|^2\big)dx\,dt,$$
where $\nu$ denotes the conormal direction associated with $(a_{jk})$?
artifact.status_search_result: Recent works (e.g., on a refined stochastic wave equation, 2023, and a refined stochastic hyperbolic equation with internal controls, 2025) extend exact-controllability results, but none located explicitly resolves whether the boundary-controlled refined stochastic hyperbolic system remains exactly controllable when the diffusion control $g$ is upgraded from $L^2_{\mathcal F}(0,T;H^{-1}(G))$ to $L^2_{\mathcal F}(0,T;L^2(G))$. The status could not be conclusively verified.

status_evidence.title: Exact Controllability for a Refined Stochastic Wave Equation (SIAM J. Control Optim.)
status_evidence.snippet: Establishes exact controllability for the refined stochastic wave equation via a Carleman estimate, with the diffusion control taken in H^{-1}.
status_evidence.claim: The known result uses g in the larger H^{-1} class; the L^2(G) regularity question is not addressed.

status_evidence.title: Exact Controllability for a Refined Stochastic Hyperbolic Equation with Internal Controls (SIAM J. Control Optim., 2025)
status_evidence.snippet: First result on internal exact controllability for a refined stochastic hyperbolic system, with relaxed regularity for control inputs.
status_evidence.claim: A 2025 follow-up paper considers the internal-control case with relaxed regularity, but does not clearly resolve the boundary-controlled L^2(G) variant.

status_evidence.title: Exact controllability for a refined Stochastic Wave Equation (arXiv:2211.15038)
status_evidence.snippet: Refined stochastic wave equation with three controls; controllability via Carleman estimate.
status_evidence.claim: Confirms the baseline result with g in H^{-1}; does not address the stricter L^2(G) regularity.
